question: According the Census 2011 of India, which state of India has the second highest literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mizoram has the second highest literacy rate in India as per the Census 2011.
 
• The literacy rate in Mizoram is 91.33%, which is just below Kerala, the state with the highest literacy rate.
 
• Mizoram has consistently focused on improving its education system, which has resulted in a high literacy rate.
 
• The state has numerous educational institutions and initiatives that have contributed to its high literacy levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literacy Rate:**

 
 
• It is the percentage of people who are able to read and write with understanding in a specific population.
 
• It is a key social indicator of the development of a region or country.
 
• High literacy rates are often associated with better socio-economic development.
 
 
 
• **Census 2011:**
 
 
• The Census of India 2011 was the 15th Census of India since 1871.
 
• It provides comprehensive data on the population, including various socio-economic indicators like literacy, employment, and housing.
 
• The data collected helps in planning and implementing government policies and programs.
 
 
 
• **Education Initiatives in Mizoram:**
 
 
• Various government and non-governmental initiatives have been undertaken to promote education in Mizoram.
 
• The state has implemented programs to improve school infrastructure and provide free textbooks and uniforms.
 
• Special emphasis is placed on the education of girls and marginalized communities.
 
• Adult education programs have also been introduced to improve the literacy rate among the adult population.
